<a href="/nba/news/analysis">Analysis</a>
<div class="primary-nav-ddl">
<div class="portal" style="max-width: 50em;">
<div class="secondary-story-container" style="border-top: 0;"><div class="secondary-story">
<a class="article-image" href="/analysis/279244/Why-The-Luka-Trade-Will-Never-Be-Forgiven" style="background-image: url('https://basketball.realgm.com/images/nba/4.2/wiretap/photos/2006/Doncic_Luka_lal_250203.jpg');"></a>
<div class="article-title"><a style="padding-left: 0;" href="/analysis/279244/Why-The-Luka-Trade-Will-Never-Be-Forgiven">Why The Luka Trade Will Never Be Forgiven</a></div>
<p class="author-details" style="margin: 0 0 0.5em;">
by <a href='/news/analysis/author/226/John-Wilmes' style='text-decoration: none;'>John Wilmes</a></p>
<div class='article-content' style='font-weight: normal;'>Luka Doncic has meant something more than what wins and losses do. He is famous, himself, and alive in a way that is wholly original and that will likely prove timeless.</div>
</div>
<div class="secondary-story">
<a class="article-image" href="/analysis/279229/Lakers-Exceptionalism-Vs-Mavericks-More-Toward-A-More-Conventional-Goodness" style="background-image: url('https://basketball.realgm.com/images/nba/4.2/wiretap/photos/2006/Doncic_Luka_lal_250207.jpg');"></a>
<div class="article-title"><a style="padding-left: 0;" href="/analysis/279229/Lakers-Exceptionalism-Vs-Mavericks-More-Toward-A-More-Conventional-Goodness">Lakers' Exceptionalism Vs. Mavericks' More Toward A More Conventional Goodness</a></div>
<p class="author-details" style="margin: 0 0 0.5em;">
by <a href='/news/analysis/author/248/Jack-Tien-Dana' style='text-decoration: none;'>Jack Tien-Dana</a></p>
<div class='article-content' style='font-weight: normal;'>Whereas the Lakers' inevitable jackpot is proof of how the league works, the Mavs are foolishly clinging to a fantasy about how it should be.</div>
</div>
<div class="secondary-story">
<a class="article-image" href="/analysis/279089/Who-Are-The-Lakers-And-Mavericks-Now" style="background-image: url('https://basketball.realgm.com/images/nba/4.2/wiretap/photos/2006/Doncic_Luka_lal_250210.jpg');"></a>
<div class="article-title"><a style="padding-left: 0;" href="/analysis/279089/Who-Are-The-Lakers-And-Mavericks-Now">Who Are The Lakers And Mavericks Now?</a></div>
<p class="author-details" style="margin: 0 0 0.5em;">
by <a href='/news/analysis/author/226/John-Wilmes' style='text-decoration: none;'>John Wilmes</a></p>
<div class='article-content' style='font-weight: normal;'>Unwilling to see Luka Doncic through whatever plagues him, the Mavericks just sent him to a task much harder than the one they'd given him. If he can do it, basketball mythology will have to revise its definition of "forever."</div>
</div>
<div class="secondary-story">
<a class="article-image" href="/analysis/279056/LeBron-James-Old-Man-Reinvention" style="background-image: url('https://basketball.realgm.com/images/nba/4.2/wiretap/photos/2006/James_LeBron_lal_240203.jpg');"></a>
<div class="article-title"><a style="padding-left: 0;" href="/analysis/279056/LeBron-James-Old-Man-Reinvention">LeBron James' Old Man Reinvention</a></div>

<table class="basketball force-table">
<tr><td><strong>Jun 22, 2017</strong> - The Brooklyn Nets selected Jarrett Allen in Round 1 with Pick 22 in the 2017 NBA Draft.</td></tr>

<tr><td><strong>Oct 15, 2018</strong> - The Brooklyn Nets exercised their Team Option to extend the contract of Jarrett Allen.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Oct 14, 2019</strong> - The Brooklyn Nets exercised their Team Option to extend the contract of Jarrett Allen.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Jan 16, 2021</strong> - Jarrett Allen was acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers, along with <a target="_blank" href="/player/Taurean-Prince/Summary/42410">Taurean Prince</a>, the draft rights to <a target="_blank" href="/player/Sasha-Vezenkov/Summary/27768">Sasha Vezenkov</a> and a Swap 2024 2nd round picks, from the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for <a target="_blank" href="/player/Dante-Exum/Summary/28245">Dante Exum</a>, a conditional 2022 1st round pick (MIL own) and a TPE.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Jul 23, 2021</strong> - The Cleveland Cavaliers tendered a Qualifying Offer to make Jarrett Allen a Restricted FA.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Aug 3, 2021</strong> - Jarrett Allen, previously with the Cleveland Cavaliers, became a free agent.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Aug 6, 2021</strong> - Jarrett Allen signed a multi-year contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers.</td></tr>
<tr><td class="dleague"><strong>Oct 31, 2023</strong> - The Cleveland Cavaliers assigned Jarrett Allen to the Cleveland Charge of the G League.</td></tr>
<tr><td class="dleague"><strong>Oct 31, 2023</strong> - The Cleveland Cavaliers recalled Jarrett Allen from the Cleveland Charge of the G League.</td></tr>
<tr><td class="dleague"><strong>Nov 1, 2023</strong> - The Cleveland Cavaliers assigned Jarrett Allen to the Cleveland Charge of the G League.</td></tr>
<tr><td class="dleague"><strong>Nov 1, 2023</strong> - The Cleveland Cavaliers recalled Jarrett Allen from the Cleveland Charge of the G League.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Aug 2, 2024</strong> - Jarrett Allen signed a veteran extension with the Cleveland Cavaliers.</td></tr>
</table>

<h2 style="font-size: 1.7em;">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the age of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen is 26 years old.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the height of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen is 6-9 (206cm) tall.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the weight of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen is 243 lbs (110kg).</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the birthday of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen was born on Apr 21, 1998.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What position does Jarrett Allen play?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen plays the C position.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What was the pre-draft team of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen was drafted out of <a href="/ncaa/conferences/Southeastern-Conference/8/Texas/60">Texas</a>.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What high school did Jarrett Allen attend?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen attended <a href="/highschool/teams/3258/St-Stephens-Episcopal-School-TX">St. Stephen's Episcopal School</a> in Austin, Texas.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What AAU team did Jarrett Allen play for?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen played AAU basketball for Pro Skill Sports (TX).</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What nationality is Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen has a <a href='/info/nationality/1/United-States/A'>United States</a> nationality.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">Where was Jarrett Allen born?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen was born in Round Rock, Texas.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the jersey number of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen last wore the #31 jersey number.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What team does Jarrett Allen play for?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen current players for the <a href='/nba/teams/Cleveland-Cavaliers/5/Home'>Cleveland Cavaliers</a>.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">Who is Jarrett Allen's agent?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen's agent is <a href='/info/agent_clients/Jim-Tanner/5'>Jim Tanner</a>, <a href='/info/agent_clients/Derrick-Powell/168'>Derrick Powell</a>.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">How many NBA seasons has Jarrett Allen played?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen played 8 seasons in the NBA.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What are the career averages of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen had career averages 12.8 points, 9.2 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.3 blocks, 0.6 steals in 538 games.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What are the career totals of Jarrett Allen?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen had career totals of 6,893 points, 4,976 rebounds, 895 assists, 680 blocks, 342 steals in 538 games.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">When can Jarrett Allen become a free agent?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen has a free agent status of UFA-2029.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">How many teams has Jarrett Allen been on?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen played for 2 NBA teams in his career - Brooklyn Nets, Cleveland Cavaliers.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">When was Jarrett Allen drafted?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen was drafted in the 1st round (#22 overall) of the 2017 NBA Draft by the Brooklyn Nets.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is Jarrett Allen's career high in points?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen averaged a career high 16.5 points per game in 2023-2024.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is Jarrett Allen's career high in rebounds?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen averaged a career high 10.8 rebounds per game in 2021-2022.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is Jarrett Allen's career high in assists?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen averaged a career high 2.7 assists per game in 2023-2024.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">What is the career PER of Jarrett Allen's?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen had a career PER of 20.4.</p>
<h4 style="font-size: 1.3em; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em;">How many All-Star teams has Jarrett Allen been on?</h4>
<p>Jarrett Allen is a 1x All-Star.</p>

<p>Jarrett Allen's Instagram account is <a href="https://www.instagram.com/_bigjayy_" target="_blank">@_bigjayy_</a>.</p>
